name: Teesta River & Valley Flood / Inundation Trigger Model

symptoms.label: Upstream Catchment Cloudburst
symptoms.description: High-altitude extreme convective precipitation event over North Sikkim catchment

symptoms.label: Rapid Water Gauge Escalation (>3.2m)
symptoms.description: Teesta River gauge rising at rate >0.8m/hr approaching danger mark

symptoms.label: Culvert Debris Jam & Highway Siltation
symptoms.description: Sediment and boulder accumulation blocking bridge vents and highway culverts

symptoms.label: 100% Basin Saturation
symptoms.description: Zero infiltration capacity leading to 95% immediate overland runoff fraction

causes.label: High-Altitude Glacial Lake & Catchment Cloudburst
causes.description: Extreme localized convective storm cell dumping >80mm/2hr in Upper Teesta basin

causes.label: Narrow Gorge Riparian Bottleneck
causes.description: Constricted valley cross-section causing water backflow and rapid inundation

causes.label: Aggraded Riverbed Silt & Debris
causes.description: Heavy sediment load from landslide deposits reducing effective channel discharge capacity

causes.label: Hydro Dam Peak Spillway Release
causes.description: Controlled reservoir peak surcharge release through radial gates during flood surge
